resolution_note: Review and correct the VPN profile and gateway configuration.

short_description: Application endpoint returns server error
description: The application endpoint returns server errors while its backend service is unavailable. The problem began after a recent system change.
resolution_note: Inspect application logs, identify the service failure and restore normal operation.

short_description: Server memory usage reaches critical level
description: Reported incident: The application becomes unresponsive when server memory usage reaches a critical level.
resolution_note: Investigate memory usage, identify excessive processes and optimize resource allocation.

short_description: Application reports certificate validation failure
description: Clients reject HTTPS requests after the server certificate expires. The issue was reported during normal business hours.
resolution_note: Renew and install the valid certificate, then verify the secure connection.

short_description: Internal hostname cannot be resolved
description: Reported incident: Users cannot open an internal application because its hostname fails to resolve.
resolution_note: Check DNS records, resolver configuration and name resolution.

short_description: Secure application access fails certificate check
description: Reported incident: Users cannot securely access the application because certificate validation fails.
resolution_note: Renew and install the valid certificate, then verify the secure connection.

short_description: DNS lookup fails for business application
description: DNS queries time out when clients attempt to locate an internal service.
resolution_note: Check DNS records, resolver configuration and name resolution.

short_description: Hostname access fails while IP access works
description: Multiple clients experience hostname lookup failures on the office network.
resolution_note: Check DNS records, resolver configuration and name resolution.

short_description: Connection pool cannot reach database server
description: The application logs connection errors while attempting to reach the configured database server.
resolution_note: Restore database connectivity and verify the connection settings and service availability.

short_description: Internal hostname cannot be resolved
description: Users cannot open an internal application because its hostname fails to resolve.
resolution_note: Check DNS records, resolver configuration and name resolution.

short_description: Server disk is almost full
description: The server cannot write application logs because the system disk has run out of space. The issue affects one employee.
resolution_note: Free unnecessary storage, review log retention and expand capacity if required.

short_description: Disk usage reaches critical threshold
description: Database backups fail because the destination storage volume has no free space. The issue was reported during normal business hours.
resolution_note: Free unnecessary storage, review log retention and expand capacity if required.

short_description: Users cannot reach service by hostname
description: The application is reachable by IP address but not by its configured hostname.
resolution_note: Check DNS records, resolver configuration and name resolution.

short_description: Employee unable to access assigned resources
description: Reported incident: The application denies access after the user's permissions were changed.
resolution_note: Verify the user's role and grant the appropriate authorized permissions.

short_description: Server becomes unresponsive under memory load
description: Requests begin failing when application memory usage exceeds available capacity.
resolution_note: Investigate memory usage, identify excessive processes and optimize resource allocation.

short_description: Website certificate has expired
description: Browsers warn users that the website certificate has expired. The issue affects one employee.
resolution_note: Renew and install the valid certificate, then verify the secure connection.

short_description: VPN client reports a configuration mismatch
description: Reported incident: Several users receive VPN connection errors after a configuration update.
resolution_note: Review and correct the VPN profile and gateway configuration.

short_description: Intermittent disconnections affect remote workers
description: The remote access tunnel fails because the client and gateway settings do not match.
resolution_note: Review and correct the VPN profile and gateway configuration.

short_description: Business application service is unavailable
description: Users receive server errors because the business application service is not running.
resolution_note: Inspect application logs, identify the service failure and restore normal operation.

short_description: Users receive certificate expiration alerts
description: A certificate expiration alert appears when employees open the business portal. The issue affects one employee.
resolution_note: Renew and install the valid certificate, then verify the secure connection.

resolution_note: Investigate memory usage, identify excessive processes and optimize resource allocation.
